prompt: Create a centered chibi fantasy character in crisp 16-bit pixel art on a plain white background. The subject is a cute small mage/priestess named Astra, shown full body, facing forward, with a neutral slightly serious expression, large dark red eyes, pale skin, and short blond hair with straight side locks. She wears an ornate golden headpiece resembling goggles or a circlet across the forehead, with a small red jewel centered above the brow, plus dark ear-covering side pieces. Her outfit consists of exactly 6 main visible clothing/accessory pieces: a dark blue scarf/capelet wrapping around the neck and flowing to the right, a white tunic dress, a gold waist belt with a small rectangular buckle, dark brown gloves or arm guards with gold cuffs, dark boots, and a deep blue cloak or backpack-like mantle behind her sides. In her left hand she holds one tall wooden staff positioned vertically along the left side of the image; the staff has a crooked dark-brown shaft, a round top frame holding a bright cyan crystal, and exactly one small red hanging charm dangling from a short cord below the crystal. Use chunky square pixels, limited color palette, visible black/dark-brown outlines, simple cel shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients beyond pixel clusters, no text, no watermark, and keep the character occupying most of a square canvas. Customize the hair as golden blond, the eye color as dark red, the scarf color as deep navy blue, and the staff crystal color as bright cyan.

promptZh: 在纯白色背景上创建一个居中的 8-bit 像素艺术精灵，展示 1 个正面站立、表情中性的 Q 版奇幻法师角色。该角色为 Astra，是一位身材娇小的超变形女巫，拥有 金黄色 的直发、白皙的皮肤、深红色的大眼睛，以及一个额头中心镶嵌着一颗红宝石的华丽金色头饰。服装：共 5 件主要服饰，包括绕在肩部的深蓝色围巾或短披风、白色长袍、带有小型中心扣的金色腰带、黄金色手套或护臂，以及深棕色靴子。姿势：双臂自然下垂，身体比例紧凑，双脚微微分开。在角色左侧放置 1 根竖直的木质长杖；长杖拥有弯曲的深棕色杖身，顶部附近有一个镶嵌在深色框架中的蓝色菱形水晶，下方悬挂着 1 个小型红色挂饰，下部握柄处有一圈金环。采用清晰的低分辨率像素艺术风格，具有块状方形像素、硬边缘、无抗锯齿、黑色和深棕色轮廓线、暖金色高光、海军蓝阴影，呈现出简约的复古 RPG 角色精灵外观。保持构图独立、对称且易于辨识，无文字、无背景景观、无水印。
